lane: H80-DPVC: Updip Dip-Projected Basement-to-Surface Coupler, Hydrothermal Magnetite-Destruction / Clay-Cap / Geothermometer Vent Conduit & Self-Masked Fracture-Transfer OOF Ensemble with Expected-DTI Hybrid Submodular Emission

rule_1_lane_uniqueness.binding_rule: like-for-like (IR-H85-01: discriminating priors with 3px halo coverage < 0.70 for dot overlap; all priors for Spearman rank correlation; literal reading against space-filling priors also reported)

protocol_rules.rule_3_score_labeling: Every number is explicitly labeled as HOLDOUT-DTI (with evaluator version, withheld positive pixel count, and 95% spatial-block bootstrap CI) or ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED (cited from submission receipt/leaderboard). Zero projections are ever written as scores.
protocol_rules.rule_5_run_card: Canonical JSON run card emitted to run_card.json and evidence/h80_run_card.json.

candidate_hypotheses_ranked.title: Updip 60-Deg Dip-Projected Basement-to-Surface Coupler + Hydrothermal Magnetite-Destruction / Smectite Clay-Cap / Geothermometer Vent Conduit + Self-Masked Fracture-Transfer OOF Ensemble with Expected-DTI Skeleton-Submodular Hybrid Emission
layers_involved: training_features.tif Bands 1-19 (specifically Band 2 rtp, Band 3 tmi_hg, Band 4 geod_2ndinv, Band 5 iso_grav_anom_slope, Band 6 tc, Band 7 geod_shearrate, Band 8 geod_dilaterate, Band 9 tmi_vg, Band 11 iso_grav_anom_vg, Band 12 det_elev, Band 13 iso_grav_anom, Band 14 tmi, Band 15 depth_to_base_surf, Band 16 ieq_n100a15, Band 17 cond_surf, Band 18 iso_grav_anom_hg, Band 19 det_elev_slope)
external/lidar_scarp_features_u8.tif (Bands 1-12: 1m 3DEP LiDAR step_max, lapneg_max, lappos_max, downface_max, upface_max, cross_max, relief, coh100, strike, valid)
external/topo_10m_derived_100m_u8.tif & external/dem10_chi_100m_u8.tif & external/dem10_chi_100m_i16.tif (10m 3DEP slope, curvature, relief, aspect coherence, knickpoints, ksn, mean elevation)
external/geodawn_rad_u8.tif (K, Th, U, TC) & external/geodawn_extensions_u8.tif (ThK, UK, UTh, TMI_up150)

candidate_hypotheses_ranked.physical_signature_targeted: Updip advection of deep basement/gravity/tilt steps by Delta_u = clip(0.5 * depth_to_base * cot(60 deg), 100m, 1500m) along -grad(depth_to_base) to align mid-scarp subsurface potential-field edges with surface rupture traces; shallow hydrothermal magnetite-destruction residual (z(TMI_up150) - z(TMI)) coupled with MT smectite clay-cap lateral edges |grad(cond_surf)|, K/Th adularia-illite and U/Th redox alteration halos, and strike-anisotropic GDR-1391 geothermometer/2m-probe plumes; deconfounded 1m/10m scarp dipoles; and fold-proper self-masked fracture-transfer rays/splays/relay bridges.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.why_catches_unmapped_faults: Mapped USGS/INGENIOUS faults follow exposed bedrock range fronts (depth_to_base ~ 0). Unmapped piedmont master strands, intrabasin synthetic step-faults, and blind geothermal conduits lie over 400-2500 m of Cenozoic valley fill where gravity/magnetic gradients are displaced down-dip by 300-1400 m and where surface scarps are diffused or sealed by hydrothermal clay/sinter.
named_non_fault_mimics: Plio-Pleistocene Lake Lahontan wave-cut paleoshoreline benches at 1212 m, 1298 m, and 1334 m elevation contours (suppressed via contour-band indicator lahontan_shoreline_idx and subsurface tilt corroboration)
US Census TIGER highway/railroad embankment cuts and BLM mining disturbances (suppressed via tiger_road_distance_m and blm_closed_claim_distance_m attenuation gates)

Steep pre-Tertiary mountain-interior erosional canyon walls and V-shaped fluvial gullies (suppressed via sqrt(relief+9) normalization, cross_max fluvial division, and terrain-stratum prevalence calibration)
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.novelty_vs_prior_lanes: First lane in GEMSDOE to integrate explicit updip 60-degree basement-depth advection of Verduzco gravity/magnetic tilt and basement steps with shallow magnetite-destruction differentials (TMI_up150 - TMI), GDR-1391 chemical geothermometers, TIGER/BLM/Lahontan deconfounding, fold-proper self-masked fracture-transfer OOF stacking, and Expected-DTI 1-px ridge-skeleton + 300m submodular hybrid emission evaluated across both Seed 20 and Seed 30 holdout draws.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.expected_dti_improvement: +0.04 to +0.09 HOLDOUT-DTI over retained benchmarks (H33 fold-fair 0.0961, GEMSDOE76 0.1580, GEMSDOE77 H85-EDTI 0.1828)
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.implementation_cost: Medium (~2.5 minutes CPU runtime, < 1.1 GB RAM, 100% SHA-256-pinned data already present)

candidate_hypotheses_ranked.title: Anisotropic Crustal Transtensional Strain-Rate Tensor x Spectral Poisson Pseudogravity Deficit
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.physical_signature_targeted: Transtensional obliquity ratio (geod_shearrate * max(geod_dilaterate, 0) / geod_2ndinv) coupled with spectral Poisson pseudogravity anomaly residual.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.why_catches_unmapped_faults: Walker Lane - Basin and Range transition faults accommodate oblique transtensional strain without mature vertical range-front topographic scarps.
named_non_fault_mimics: Mafic/felsic pluton margins with strong remanent magnetization and GPS interpolation smoothing lobes
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.novelty_vs_prior_lanes: Explicit strain-rate tensor obliquity invariants multiplied by Poisson pseudogravity residuals.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.implementation_cost: Low (~45s CPU), lower spatial resolution (~2-5 km geodetic footprint); key transtensional strain terms incorporated into H80-A.

candidate_hypotheses_ranked.title: Multi-Azimuth Log-Gabor Phase-Congruency Quadrature Filter Bank on Potential-Field Analytic Signals
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.physical_signature_targeted: Dimensionless multi-scale Kovesi phase congruency across Hilbert-pair quadrature filters at 300 m, 900 m, and 2100 m wavelengths.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.why_catches_unmapped_faults: Amplitude-invariant phase alignment detects deeply buried intrabasin basement steps attenuated by 1/z^2 sedimentary cover.
named_non_fault_mimics: Aeromagnetic flight-line leveling striping and pre-Cenozoic metamorphic foliation
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.novelty_vs_prior_lanes: Pure frequency-domain phase congruency on joint gravity/magnetic analytic signals.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.implementation_cost: Medium-High (2D FFT quadrature bank across 8 orientations).

candidate_hypotheses_ranked.title: Radiometric Potassium-Adularia / Thorium-Immobilization Alteration Halo & Epithermal Sinter Leaching Detector
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.physical_signature_targeted: Cross-strike dipole of high K/Th (potassic adularia boiling-zone alteration) flanked by low TC / elevated U/Th (opal-A sinter silica flooding and redox uranium fronts).
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.why_catches_unmapped_faults: Hydrothermal sinter terraces and argillic alteration cement and flatten fault traces, masking topographic scarps while leaving a gamma-ray spectrometric signature.
named_non_fault_mimics: Rhyolitic ash-flow tuff outcrops and potassium-enriched evaporitic playa brines
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.novelty_vs_prior_lanes: Dedicated gamma-ray spectrometric alteration dipole; key channels integrated into H80-A Domain B.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.expected_dti_improvement: +0.005 standalone HOLDOUT-DTI (+0.018 when fused in H80-A)

candidate_hypotheses_ranked.title: Sentinel-1 InSAR Persistent Scatterer / SBAS Interseismic & Hydrothermal Pore-Pressure Phase Gradient
layers_involved: External NASA ASF / JPL ARIA Sentinel-1 geocoded unwrapped interferograms & COMET LiCSAR LOS velocity grids (https://asf.alaska.edu/, https://aria-share.jpl.nasa.gov/)
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.physical_signature_targeted: Across-strike line-of-sight velocity and seasonal thermo-poroelastic deformation gradient |grad(v_LOS)| across creeping or breathing blind geothermal faults.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.why_catches_unmapped_faults: Directly senses active sub-centimeter surface deformation across flat Holocene playas where wind/water erosion erases topographic scarps.
named_non_fault_mimics: Agricultural groundwater pumping subsidence cones, playa soil-moisture dielectric phase delays, and topographic tropospheric phase screens
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.novelty_vs_prior_lanes: Direct satellite radar interferometric deformation gradient.
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.expected_dti_improvement: +0.020 to +0.035 HOLDOUT-DTI if full-footprint ARIA/LiCSAR stack is pre-staged
candidate_hypotheses_ranked.implementation_cost: Blocked in current sandbox by outbound host allowlist (asf.alaska.edu / aria-share.jpl.nasa.gov not in sandbox outbound allowlist); documented with official free data URLs for unrestricted staging.

preregistered_experiments.name: Pure Label-Free Multi-Physics + Updip 60-Deg Basement Advection + Hydrothermal Vent Conduit HGB (Zero Catalogue Geometry)
preregistered_experiments.description: Evaluates the 54-channel label-free static stack (including updip 60-deg normal-fault basement/gravity/tilt advection, shallow magnetite-destruction differential, MT clay-cap edges, GDR-1391 geothermometer plumes, and TIGER/BLM/Lahontan deconfounded 1m/10m scarp dipoles) with zero catalogue-derived geometry features on both Seed 20 and Seed 30 holdout draws.

preregistered_experiments.name: H80-DPVC Multi-Physics + Fold-Proper Self-Masked Fracture-Transfer OOF Stack at Fixed H33 Budget (37,654 Dots, Submodular 300m)
preregistered_experiments.description: Adds the 9 fold-proper visible-only fracture-transfer channels (collinear tip rays, wing-crack splays, en-echelon relay bridges, strike corridors, completeness deficit, and stress tendency) trained via 3-subfold self-masking strictly inside fold['visible'], emitted at the exact H33 budget of 37,654 dots via 300 m kernel submodular max-cover.

preregistered_experiments.name: H80-DPVC Hero Deliverable: Multi-Physics + Updip-Advected + Self-Masked OOF Meta-Surface with Expected-DTI Collar-Aware 1-px Ridge-Skeleton + 300m Submodular Hybrid Allocation
preregistered_experiments.description: Combines the fold-proper H80-DPVC meta-surface and label-free updip-geothermal physics surface with a collar-aware (d_cat > 2.6 px) 1-px local-maximum ridge-skeleton + 300m submodular hybrid emitter that eliminates redundant adjacent pixel FP waste and maximizes pooled HOLDOUT-DTI across both Seed 20 and Seed 30 while strictly satisfying the 133-raster uniqueness gate (|Spearman rho| <= 0.90 and discriminating 3-px overlap <= 0.70).
